title: Phase 15: End-to-End Execution Flow & Integration Tests
description:
Connect all systems into a working vertical slice. End-to-end validation of the complete Spark v4.0 actor architecture.

**MVP End-to-End Flow:**
1. User runs Spark CLI
2. User enters /code Add feature X
3. CLI sends goal to Orchestrator
4. Orchestrator uses mock or real LLM to generate plan
5. CLI displays plan → User approves
6. Orchestrator sends tasks to Dispatcher
7. Dispatcher queues and spawns up to max_concurrency Workers
8. Workers execute using tools → publish results
9. Dispatcher updates queue → Orchestrator reconciles
10. Orchestrator reviews → CLI displays final summary
11. Bronze memory contains full event log

**Hot Reload E2E Scenario:**
Edit worker.md → Watcher detects → Coordinator validates → Prompt.Store updates → EventBus publishes → CLI shows reload → Running Worker continues → New Worker uses updated prompt → Bronze logs reload event.

**Required Integration Tests:** Full plan execution (mock LLM + fake tools), concurrency=3 execution, Worker crash+retry, policy denial, hot prompt reload during execution, hot config reload changes concurrency, hot tool reload affects new Worker, final review after all tasks.

**Milestone:** MVP-7 Production Hardening

title: Phase 12: Memory, Compaction & Session Logs
description:
Implement durable memory tiers without breaking prefix caching.

**Deliverables:**
- Bronze Memory: JSONL append of every important event to ~/.spark/sessions/<uuid>.jsonl (user input, plans, approvals, task lifecycle, worker results, tool calls/results, errors, hot reload events, config/prompt changes, final answer). Secret redaction, large payload truncation.
- Silver Memory: Compacted session summaries (triggered by token threshold, milestone, /compact command, or before final review). Preserves unresolved issues, arch decisions, user constraints, tool outcomes. Never compacts cached prefix.
- Gold Memory: Long-term distilled knowledge at ~/.spark/memory/gold.md (arch decisions, user preferences, project conventions, pitfalls, implementation notes). Curated, not raw dumps.
- Cache Integration: Static prompt + project rules + gold memory = cacheable; silver summaries + dynamic history = non-cacheable.

**Hot Reload Contract:** Memory config reload enables/disables tiers; prompt reload does not erase memory; compaction reloads summarization prompt; Bronze logs include hot reload events.

**Milestone:** MVP-7 Production Hardening

title: Phase 11: Guidance System

**Example Triggers:** After read_file → summarize only relevant; after grep → inspect surrounding code; after failed edit → reread target; after shell failure → inspect error; after truncation → narrow search.

**Hot Reload Contract:** Editing guidance file updates future injections; existing Worker may use new guidance on next tool result if configured; invalid guidance file rejected safely.

**Milestone:** MVP-7 Production Hardening
